description:
Cast Cerulean Wisps by paying {U}, causing Emmara to become blue until end of turn and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Grand Architect's second ability by tapping Emmara, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells and/or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
